name: TwittrAPI: new mentions to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## New mentions to Google Sheets
Every 15 minutes: search the latest tweets that mention `@yourbrand`, keep only tweets not seen before and append them to a sheet named **Mentions** (columns: id, createdAt, username, text, likes, retweets, replies, url).

Replace `@yourbrand`, the sheet URL and both credentials, then activate the workflow. One search = one API call per run.
